simple.meaning: יוֹנֶקֶת (yôwneqeth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a sprout.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Job 8:16. The surrounding context includes mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יוֹנֶקֶת (H3127) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: יוֹנֶקֶת (yôwneqeth) / H3127 is traced through Job 8:16, Job 14:7, Job 15:30, Psalms 80:12 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H3127. yoneqeth [ יוֺנֶ֫קֶת ] noun feminine young shoot, twig (= foregoing) — יוֺנַקְתּוֺ Job 8:16 2 t.; יוֺנְקוֺתָיו Hosea 14:7 ; יֹנְקוֺתָיו Ezek 17:22 ; יוֺנְקוֺתֶיהָ Psa 80:12 ; — shoot, twig , of tree Job 14:7 ; cf wicked under figure of tree 8:16 ; 15:30 ; Israel under figure of olive-tree Hosea 14:7 , of cedar Ezek 17:22 , of vine Psa 80:12 .

occurrences.englishText: He is green before the sun.
“For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down,
He will not depart out of darkness.
Why have you broken down its walls,

“The Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
Men will dwell in his shade.
